name: inline-marks
description: The anchor for the marks the renderer paints AROUND a run of inline text rather than in it: a codespan's tint, a key cap's box and the air the theme puts between two of them, a highlight, a superscript and a subscript's displacement, a footnote marker's colour, and the attribution under a quotation. Every one of them is drawn by the text formatter from the text fragment's own extent, which is a different thing from the line box a browser would paint over — and every one of them was wrong while the typographic anchors passed.
